links.outcome: Inpatient fall incidence and fall-related injuries before vs after AI video monitoring implementation
links.effect: Fall rate 1.017 vs 1.286 per 1000 patient-days (exposed vs non-exposed), but no statistically significant effect in Firth logistic or Cox regression.
links.quote: However, penalized likelihood logistic regression and Cox proportional hazards regression revealed no statistically significant effect of artificial intelligence-assisted video monitoring on fall reduction.

screen.reason: Retrospective matched cohort study evaluating the real-world clinical deployment effect of an AI-assisted video monitoring system on inpatient fall incidence rates.
